description: Per-category staleness thresholds (Phase 4.3), replacing the single global 24-month fatal / 18-month warn limit tools/validate_corpus.py used before this file existed. Values are the master plan's own suggestion: categories with faster-moving law (Hiring, During employment, Ending employment, Real Estate) get the tightest window; Business Formation and Family Law sit in the middle; Confidentiality & IP and Estate Planning keep the original, slower-moving window. A clause used by documents in more than one category (including documents that themselves carry two categories) is held to the strictest (lowest) threshold among all of them -- see tools/validate_corpus.py.
